segments.oily: Several reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin report the product controls shine and oil through the day without feeling greasy, slick, or heavy, giving a dewy rather than oily finish.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including dry acne-prone and dry sensitive skin, report deep hydration, soothed dry patches, and a plumped feel, though one combination-dry reviewer found it sat tackily on top of dry patches instead of absorbing.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including oily-leaning and dry-leaning combination, describe balanced hydration and oil control with a lightweight, non-greasy finish.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers report gentle wear with no irritation or breakouts, but one describes a mild burning sensation and temporary redness with repeated use, and another tolerates the fragrance without loving it.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her 30s dealing with early aging signs reports the gel-cream texture stays nourishing without greasiness even on oily-leaning mature skin.

concerns.aging: One reviewer managing early signs of aging in oily-leaning skin reports the product stays nourishing and non-greasy in warm weather.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe visible relief from dehydration or dryness, citing softness, plumpness, and all-day hydration; one dry-combination reviewer is an exception, finding it left skin tacky and sitting on the surface rather than absorbing.
concerns.redness: One rosacea-prone reviewer reports the product calms and hydrates without aggravating redness, while another reviewer notes mild redness and a brief burning sensation on application.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers mention using it on irritated, sun-exposed, or eczema-affected skin without issues, describing a soothing, non-aggravating feel; no barrier-damage complaints are reported.
concerns.spots: One reviewer notes dry spots from previous breakouts were soothed and pores were not clogged.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and describe the formula as compatible with blemish-prone skin; no reviewer reports it caused breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple oily-skin reviewers report reduced shine and better oil control over the day; one describes a brief initial dewy/shiny look that settles down.
